notes: Owner analysis: the product now reads its owner's own words and tells him what it noticed. A local engine (zero model tokens, no cloud, no network) scores the keywords in your own session history and files each one on four axes - trait (keen / retrieval gap / empathy partial / growth), topic, information tier (L1 act now / L2 update / L3 background) and coverage - with the full evidence attached: message count, distinct days, first and last seen, the score breakdown, and dated excerpts. Every row expands to what the analysis actually saw; a keyword seen once is marked weak, never presented as an interest. The SENSE board grows an OWNER ANALYSIS card (KEYWORDS / DIMENSIONS / GAPS / KNOWLEDGE) with an ANALYZE NOW button, and the board itself can be reopened from any chat: /sniff status | run | pause turns it back on and sweeps, and the switch persists across restarts. P1 adds the closed loop: the retrieval gaps are searched on the outer web (keyless, no credential, default OFF - the owner flips one switch; only the keyword query ever leaves the machine), the results are filed as knowledge cards with their tier rule shown, and the urgent rows are raised as ordinary SNIFF findings that the existing delivery chain speaks - passive by default, so nothing talks until you say so. Program operations are proposals only: the owner clicks one, and only then is it written. Nothing is actuated, nothing is uploaded, and no token is spent.
